method.clip: TeslaSync derives session-level aggregates locally and clips every vehicle to documented bounds.
method.cohort: Only coarse model-family and five-year model-year buckets define similarity; precise location is excluded.
method.limit: Differential privacy protects aggregate contributions. It does not make a tiny local fleet representative, comparable, or suitable for causal conclusions.
method.noise: Crypto-secure Laplace noise is applied to fixed histograms before means, ranges and percentiles are calculated.
method.stable: A release ID is reused until the completed source period or cohort membership version changes.
method.title: Methodology & limits

metrics.empty: Metric cards remain unavailable until an eligible private release exists.
